integrity: The supplied code exactly enumerates all fifteen matchings and sixteen even-subset classes for each of the eleven integer partitions of six. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on the separability and six finite branch points of an odd-characteristic genus-two sextic; the eleven rows classify finite-etale subgroup-scheme descent, not codomains or isogeny maps. This is a table of the classical S6 action, not a new general Galois-action theorem. An equivalent older tabulation could exist.
title: Nine Frobenius spectra of the fifteen genus-two Richelot kernels
